verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS billing platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents importing and migrating data into Stripe (migration toolkit, data migrations), plus general APIs and webhooks. Those are developer building blocks, not a documented bulk export in open formats. No evidence shows a documented way to export all data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
